create.name: Sharon Smith
create.bio:
Sharon Smith is a New York teacher of Taoist practice who has studied qigong, tai chi and Taoist meditation for more than four decades. She was among the first Western students of Mantak Chia in 1981 and holds senior instructor and Chi Nei Tsang credentials in his Universal Healing Tao. She is authorised as well to teach Sheng Zhen Gong in the line of Li Junfeng, trained at a Wudang martial arts academy in China, and has kept up an Iyengar yoga practice for over thirty-five years. Other teachers she credits include Ming Chan, T.K. Shih and the scholar Livia Kohn.

She teaches small weekly tai chi classes in Manhattan alongside workshops, private sessions and retreats abroad, and over the years has taught at the New York Open Center, Kripalu, Omega and Mantak Chia's Tao Garden in Thailand, as well as in community and senior centres. She hosted The Shift Network's online Qigong Global Summits from 2020 to 2022, and since 2017 has organised the Immortal Sisters gatherings, retreats that bring women teachers of the Tao together to practise with the yin side of the tradition. She is also a photographer whose work is held in several museum collections.

courses.title: Immortal Sisters Conference: Tend the Fire (Costa Rica)
courses.description: A week-long retreat on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast that brings together women teachers of qigong and the Tao, with two to three hours of practice and meditation a day, shared meals and a visit to a Bribri village. Sharon created and directs the gathering.

courses.title: Tai Chi for Everyone (weekly class, New York)
courses.description: Small daytime tai chi classes on Wednesdays in Manhattan, run as seasonal series with a beginners' hour followed by the 108-movement Yang form. Drop-ins are possible.

Identity: 'Sharon Smith' is a common name; matched to the Shift list through her own site's Shift summit references and YouTube interviews titled with the Shift Network.

Base: her site gives no home town; recorded as New York from the venue of her regular weekly class (The Center, West 13th Street, Manhattan) on her events page, and her 646 phone number. City level only.
Availability set to 'local' (weekly in-person classes and retreats); no online classes seen on her site, though she has taught online summits.
Email taopracticeforchallengingtimes@gmail.com is shown in the header of every page; a second address on her pages is masked with asterisks and not used.

Her site frames tai chi and qigong around health benefits (pain, stress, illness) on its Benefits and Chi Nei Tsang pages; the listing uses only practice-led items and her bio makes no health claims. Owner may want to look.
Second photo (fan form at Wudang, 650 px) is captioned on her own About page as her at the Purple Palace, 2011.
